quotes.text: Copilot is the assistant you chat with, and it mostly lives in the cloud. A co-pilot plus PC is the hardware underneath, and it's the part that can run some of that work on your own desk.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clears up the most common confusion between the Copilot assistant and Copilot+ PC hardware.

quotes.text: Forty tops describes what the chip can do, not how fast the laptop feels in everyday tasks like opening a browser. A machine can have a brilliant NPU and still feel slow if it's short on memory.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Warns against reading the TOPS rating as overall laptop speed.

quotes.text: An NPU is a piece of hardware, and it can only help when the software is written to use it. That's the real reason the badge exists at all.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why the badge links hardware to software support.

quotes.text: The strongest safeguard is that recall is opt in. If you don't turn it on, nothing gets saved and you can remove the whole thing whenever you like.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names the key privacy control behind Recall in plain terms.

quotes.text: The fix is to ignore the word AI on the box and check for two things. Look for the Copilot Plus badge and look for a chip from one of the three qualifying families.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Gives buyers a simple, actionable check in the store.

takeaways: A Copilot+ PC is a Windows 11 laptop with an NPU rated at 40 TOPS or more, plus at least 16 GB of memory and 256 GB of storage.
On-device features such as Recall, Click to Do, improved Windows Search and Live Captions run on the NPU, which makes them fast, offline-capable and power efficient.
Recall is opt in, keeps encrypted snapshots on the device behind Windows Hello, and lets users pause, filter or delete what it saves.
hook: Every new Windows laptop claims to be an AI PC, but only some earn the Copilot+ badge. This episode explains for buyers and IT beginners what the 40 TOPS NPU requirement means, which AI features run locally and what happens to your data with Recall. You will know how to check a laptop before you buy and whether you need one yet.
